youtube.title: Noodle's ABC: A to E! (ACHOO!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🔤 ACHOO! Noodle sneezed and all the letter blocks flew away! Can you help find them?

Learn the letters A, B, C, D and E with Noodle, the nerdiest noodle bowl in class! Each letter block comes back one by one with a word that starts with it: A is for apple, B is for ball, and more. Then sing the ABC song together, and stay till the end, because someone sneaks in a little too early! 🐟

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn the letters A, B, C, D and E
✔️ Hear a word for each letter (A is for apple!)
✔️ Practice early phonics and letter sounds
✔️ Sing a catchy ABC song with Noodle!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 ACHOO! Oh no!
0:05 Let's find the letters!
0:22 Sing along!
0:40 Wait... who's that?
0:52 What starts with F?

💬 What word starts with F? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Subscribe to Nerdy Noodles for more funny learning videos for kids!
